skill.name: personwise-lead-magnet
skill.description: Creates grounded, interactive digital-human lead magnet courses from supplied expertise and materials through the PersonWise CLI.
skill.summary: Turn supplied expertise into an askable lead magnet mini course.
skill.author: personwiseai

security_audit.summary: The static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, bounded installer checks, fixed verified downloads, and signed descriptor data. One high-severity semantic risk remains because the workflow executes an update command supplied by an external service without a local command allowlist.

remediation.issue: The update workflow accepts a free-form action command from a service response.
remediation.suggestion: Parse the action into arguments, require the PersonWise executable and an exact allowlist of update subcommands and flags, then reject shell metacharacters.

content.user_title: Build an Interactive Lead Magnet Course
content.value_statement: Static lead magnets often provide limited engagement and weak learning evidence. This skill turns supplied expertise into a grounded, askable PersonWise mini course.
actual_capabilities: Designs a focused lead magnet teaching arc from supplied expertise and source materials.
Creates private or link-access PersonWise courses through structured CLI workflows.
Uploads user-selected documents and tracks each source until processing completes.
Reviews generated outlines, scripts, slide text, and images at durable checkpoints.
Resumes, repairs, refines, publishes, and queries existing PersonWise course runs.
Returns run evidence, source status, access mode, and the correct course URL.
limitations: Requires PersonWise CLI 1.1.6 or newer, browser OAuth, service access, and available course credits.
Does not create paid products or complete curriculum programs.
Cannot add facts, testimonials, outcomes, or certifications unsupported by supplied materials.
Course generation and source processing depend on the PersonWise service.

use_cases.title: Convert Expertise Into a Mini Course
use_cases.description: Turn articles, notes, or workshop material into a focused lead magnet that teaches one useful outcome.

use_cases.title: Launch an Interactive List Builder
use_cases.description: Create a voice-question-enabled course that delivers standalone value before presenting an honest next step.

use_cases.title: Repurpose Training Materials
use_cases.description: Build a source-grounded course from selected documents while preserving factual limits and reviewing each production checkpoint.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Lead Magnet
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-page private lead magnet mini course from [source text] for [audience], teaching [outcome].
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with supplied text and a clear audience.

prompt_templates.title: Use Documents as Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a private lead magnet from [attached files], using only those documents for factual claims and teaching [outcome].
prompt_templates.scenario: Keep the course strictly grounded in selected materials.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Shareable Course
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [page count]-page lead magnet for [audience], include [teaching arc], review every checkpoint, and enable link access.
prompt_templates.scenario: Produce a reviewed course ready for audience sharing.

prompt_templates.title: Resume and Refine a Course
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume PersonWise run [run ID], inspect current state, correct unsupported content, review changed visuals, and publish only when playable.
prompt_templates.scenario: Recover or improve an existing course using durable state.

output_examples.input: Create a private five-page lead magnet from my attached pricing workshop notes.
output_examples.output: A five-page private mini course with a focused promise, method, common mistakes, self-check, and login-required editor link.

output_examples.input: Turn my onboarding guide into a source-only interactive course for agency owners.
output: Delivery: reviewed interactive course with source status and private access evidence

output_examples.input: Publish my completed lead magnet and give me the public course link.
output_examples.output: The course is confirmed playable with link access, and the response includes the verified public share URL.

best_practices: Provide a specific audience, one practical outcome, and the strongest supporting source materials.
Name every local document or image that the skill may upload.
Review factual claims, access mode, and course playability before distributing the returned link.
anti_patterns: Do not request fabricated testimonials, guarantees, client results, or professional credentials.
Do not use this workflow for paid courses or full curriculum design.
Do not ask the skill to upload files that you did not explicitly select.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates an interactive PersonWise mini course with a digital presenter, designed slides, and grounded voice-question support.

faq.question: Can it use my documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It can upload documents that you name, attach, or explicitly select for the course.

faq.question: Does it require a PersonWise account?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow uses browser OAuth, an account alias, the PersonWise CLI, and available course credits.

faq.question: Can it publish the course publicly?
faq.answer: Yes. Request link access explicitly, or keep the default private access for login-required viewing.

faq.question: Can it invent examples or results?
faq.answer: No. Claims, examples, testimonials, and outcomes must be supported by supplied materials.

faq.question: Can it resume an interrupted course run?
faq.answer: Yes. It reads current run state, follows allowed actions, and continues from durable checkpoints.
